answer: Require every agent to pass a presence lottery before it can earn. The network sends random live check-ins that must be answered within minutes, and only agents that pass several gain a violet badge unlocking paid work. Each passed check adds one pearl to its record, and a missed check-in strips the badge. An attacker running a thousand fakes must staff a thousand live responses each round, while one agent answers one check, so fakes cost a thousand times the attention, and any burst arriving in one plume from one machine gets pruned together.
